title: 第25章 一个吃货第26章 不好说话
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
副统领道：“老大，咱们这位新城主好像很牛叉呀！”
何武呆呆的点了点头：“非常牛，他是我迄今为止见到最牛的筑基期。”
副统领也点了点头道：“他不会是联盟那位大人的私生子吧？”
何武敲了一下他脑袋道：“你不要命了，这种话也敢乱说，赶紧去打扫战场。”
副统领尴尬一笑，然后带人去打扫战场了。
城主府内
护卫都去防御魔族了，所以这里只剩一些家丁跟丫鬟。
听说城内所有人都要成为血魔的食物，大家直接瓜分了城主府的财物准备跑路。
老管家拦住众人道：“你们不能走，城主府庇护了我们，现在城中有难，我们就逃跑，跟畜生有什么区别？”
为首的一名家丁名叫大勇，他道：“老孙，赶紧让开路，否则我们不客气了，城主都失踪了，你还以为你是高高在上的总管呢？”
这些人基本都是炼气期的修为，见老孙不让路，直接将他打倒。
疯狂的向外面冲去，这时被三个年轻人拦住了去路，正是秦峰三人。
大勇道：“你是谁？敢拦我们的去路！”
秦峰道：“现任城主！”
说着他亮出了令牌。
众人顿时面色一变，老孙连滚带爬的来到秦峰脚下哭嚎道：“城主，你一定要严惩他们！”
“他们太不像话了，一有困难就跑路，还打伤了老奴。”
秦峰将老孙扶了起来。
大勇道：“你是城主又怎样？你也不能剥夺我们活的权利！”
“血魔很快就要将我们全部吞噬，难道让我们坐以待毙吗？”

其他人也都附和：“对呀，我们没有义务陪你一起死！”
秦峰淡淡道：“说的没错，你们离开我不反对。”
“但必须把钱留下，这是城主府的财物。”
众人相互对视一眼，钱留下倒也无所谓，总比丢命强。
那家丁还有些不放心：“城主不会等下反悔又把我们都杀了吧？”
旁边的柳梦瑶不屑道：“你们这些蝼蚁，都不值得我二师兄出手，把钱留下，赶紧滚！”
众人这才放下心来，把所有的资源全都留下，然后迅速跑路。
秦峰收起了所有资源。
老孙道：“城主，你怎么就这么放他们走了？”
秦峰道：“不是一条心的，留下也没什么用。”
“你很不错，以后就继续当管家吧，先给我们三个安排一间房间，然后跟我讲讲城里最近发生的事。”
老孙悲伤道：“谢谢城主对我的信任，但我劝你还是赶紧离开吧。”
“他们刚才说的是真的，血魔很快就要吞噬这里。”
秦峰有些疑惑道：“那你为什么不走？”
老孙道：“我从小就在城主府，就算死，我也要死在这里。”
秦峰感叹，真是个忠心的老仆，虽然实力不高，但是一个值得信任的人。
他拍了拍老孙的肩膀道：“去给我们找间房子吧，还有，之前那些人要回来，不要收！”
老孙一脸懵圈，这新城主莫不是傻了吧，听不懂自己说的话？
不过他也没说什么，众人刚走到内院，就见一梳着丸子头的女子正抱着一块红薯啃。
此刻两个腮帮子鼓鼓的，见到众人来了，吓得一哆嗦，手中的红薯都掉了。

双手揪着衣襟，仿佛犯了错的孩子。
老孙叹了口气道：“二丫，你又偷吃！”
content_en:
The deputy commander said: "Boss, our new city lord seems to be very awesome!"
He Wu nodded blankly: "Very awesome, he is the most awesome foundation-building stage I have seen so far."
The deputy commander also nodded and said: "Isn't he the illegitimate son of the leader of the alliance?"
He Wu knocked him on the head and said: "You don't want your life. You dare to say such nonsense. Go clean the battlefield quickly."
The deputy commander smiled awkwardly, and then led his people to clean up the battlefield.
Inside the city lord's palace
The guards have all gone to defend against the demons, so there are only some servants and maids left here.
Hearing that everyone in the city would become the blood demon's food, everyone immediately divided up the property of the city lord's mansion and prepared to run away.
The old housekeeper stopped everyone and said: "You can't leave. The city lord's palace has protected us. Now that there is trouble in the city, we just run away. What's the difference between us and animals?"
One of the leading servants was named Dayong. He said: "Old Sun, get out of the way quickly, otherwise we will not be polite. The city lord has disappeared. Do you still think you are the superior manager?"
These people were basically in the Qi refining stage. When they saw Lao Sun refusing to give way, they directly knocked him down.
He rushed outside crazily, but was blocked by three young people, none other than Qin Feng and the others.
Dayong said: "Who are you? Dare to block our way!"
Qin Feng said: "The current city lord!"
As he spoke, he showed his token.
Everyone's expressions suddenly changed. Old Sun crawled to Qin Feng's feet and cried: "City Lord, you must punish them severely!"
"They are so shameless. They run away whenever there is trouble and even hurt the old slave."
Qin Feng helped Lao Sun up.
Dayong said: "So what if you are the city lord? You can't deprive us of our right to live!"
"The Blood Demon will soon devour us all, should we just sit there and wait to die?"
Others also echoed: "Yes, we have no obligation to die with you!"
Qin Feng said calmly: "You are right, I have no objection to you leaving."
"But you must keep the money, it is the property of the city lord's mansion."
Everyone looked at each other, it didn't matter if they kept the money, it was better than losing their lives.
The servant was still a little worried: "The city lord won't regret it later and kill us all, right?"
Liu Mengyao, who was standing next to him, said disdainfully: "You ants are not worth my second brother's help. Keep your money and get out!"
Everyone felt relieved, left all their resources, and ran away quickly.
Qin Feng put away all resources.
Lao Sun said: "City Lord, why did you just let them go?"
Qin Feng said: "If you don't have the same intention, there is no use in staying."
"You are very good. Please continue to be the housekeeper from now on. First arrange a room for the three of us, and then tell me about the recent events in the city."
Lao Sun said sadly: "Thank you City Lord for trusting me, but I advise you to leave as soon as possible."
"What they just said is true, the blood demon will soon devour this place."
Qin Feng said with some confusion: "Then why don't you leave?"
Lao Sun said: "I have been in the City Lord's Mansion since I was a child. Even if I die, I will die here."
Qin Feng sighed, what a loyal old servant. Although his strength is not high, he is a trustworthy person.
He patted Lao Sun on the shoulder and said, "Go find us a house. Also, those people from before are coming back, so don't take them away!"
Old Sun looked confused. Could it be that the new city lord was stupid and couldn't understand what he said?
But he didn't say anything. As soon as everyone walked into the inner courtyard, they saw a woman with a bun hairdo holding a piece of sweet potato and gnawing on it.
At this moment, the two cheeks were bulging. When they saw the crowd coming, they were so frightened that they dropped the sweet potatoes in their hands.
His hands were holding the hem of his clothes, like a child who had made a mistake.
Lao Sun sighed and said, "Erya, you stole it again!"
